description:
Search for candidate products matching a query, each with a data-maturity tier.
query: 1-8 space-separated plain words (no SQL/special chars).
category_id: optional top-level category slug from list_categories (e.g. "pet-supplies").
sort (enum): price_asc | price_desc | rating_desc | review_count_desc. Omit for relevance order.
Relevance (default order) weights title match (3) > brand match (2) > feature-bullet match (1) per term; every term must match at least one field. matched reports the total hit count (matched=0 means no product matched every term). limit (1-100, default 20) / offset paginate; include_rating_distribution (default false) adds the rating_breakdown histogram.
Filters (all optional, combined with AND, bounds inclusive): min_price / max_price on the stored USD price, min_rating on the 0-5 average rating. Each compares against a STORED value, so setting any of them also drops products whose price or rating is unknown - matched drops for two reasons, not only for being below the threshold.
Invalid values return an error listing the allowed enum.
name: search_products
